meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.
catalogue.empty: No assets in the database yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.

quote.title: Your monthly price
quote.listPrice: List price today {price} excl. VAT · price list {version}
quote.lockNote: Signing locks the rent without VAT. VAT is set by law, so each invoice uses the rate valid on its date.
quote.notLeasable.reserved: This item is reserved for another customer.
quote.notLeasable.returned: This item is back from a lease and is being inspected. It will get a new price soon.
quote.noPrice: There is no price for this item today.
quote.refusal.below_minimum: We can't lease this: the amount to finance is below our minimum of 300 €. Try a smaller down payment.
quote.refusal.above_maximum: The amount to finance is above our maximum of 250 000 €.
quote.refusal.down_payment_not_below_pri: The down payment must be less than the price.
quote.refusal.down_payment_negative: The down payment can't be negative.
quote.refusal.unknown_term: We offer leases of 12, 24, 36 or 48 months.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.empty: No contracts yet. Sign a lease, or run the demo seed script.
contract.subtitle: {assets} · {term}-month lease
contract.lockReason.same_day: Quoted and signed on the same day, {signedOn}: that day's price, {signing}, is locked.
contract.lockReason.quote_price_honoured: The price went up after your quote on {quotedOn}, so we kept the quoted price {quoted} instead of {signing} on {signedOn}. You save {difference}.
contract.lockReason.price_dropped_since_: The price dropped after your quote on {quotedOn}: you got the lower price on the signing day {signedOn}, {signing} instead of {quoted}. You save {difference}.
contract.lockReason.quote_expired: Your quote from {quotedOn} was older than 14 days, so the price on the signing day {signedOn} applies: {signing} (quoted {quoted}, difference {difference}).
timeTravel.title: Time travel
timeTravel.intro: Replay the contract month by month.
timeTravel.vatExplain: Your rent is still locked at {net}. The VAT rate changed from {from} % to {to} % on {since}, so each invoice changed by {difference}. VAT is set by law, not by us.
timeTravel.monthEnd: Your lease started on day {day}. In shorter months the invoice is due on the last day of the month, including 29 February in leap years.
timeTravel.addsUpNo: No: the invoices do not match the contract
invoice.caption: All invoices of this contract
earlyExit.title: Leave after month {month}?
earlyExit.rule: Our rule: you pay what the lease still owes today, the rents left and the buyout, without the interest for months that won't happen. Leaving early never costs more than staying.
earlyExit.keepDetail: {net} without VAT: {rents} rents left and the buyout ({undiscounted}), minus {saved} of interest you no longer owe.
earlyExit.returnDetail: We credit its market value today, {value}. You pay {net} without VAT, never less than 0.
sign.title: Sign your lease
sign.notApproved: This application is not approved, so it can't be signed. A person will contact you if it is under review.
sign.cannotSign: This lease can't be signed right now ({reason}).
sign.signatoryOnly: The applicant can't sign for the company. The authorised signatory signs here.
sign.name: Full name of the person signing
sign.accept: I have read the terms above and accept them. The rent without VAT is locked from now on.
sign.simulated: Demo: a simulated e-signature. A real contract would be signed with strong identification such as bank ID.
apply.title: Apply for a lease
apply.intro: Three short steps. We only ask what we need, and we tell you why.
apply.empty: There is nothing to apply for yet. Run npm run db:setup and reload.
apply.deal.title: What do you want to lease?
apply.field.customerHelp: Demo people. Pick one and the answers below fill in by themselves. You can change them.
apply.notAvailable: This item is "{status}" and cannot be leased right now. Please pick another.
apply.qtyBad: Please type a whole number from 1 to 99.
apply.field.downHelp: Paid at the start. A bigger down payment means a smaller monthly rent. Leave empty for none.
apply.downTooHigh: The down payment must be smaller than the price of the item.
apply.moneyBad: Please type an amount like 2500 or 2500,50.
apply.summary: Total price excl. VAT: {price}. Amount we finance: {financed}.
apply.you.title: About you
apply.you.intro: Only the questions that matter for your choice are shown. If you change something above, this list may change.
apply.fromRecord: Taken from your customer record. It cannot be changed here.
apply.cleared: Because of your change we no longer need these answers, so we removed them: {list}.
apply.send.title: Send it
apply.send.intro: We check your application right away and show the result on this page.
apply.errors.fix: Some fields need a look. They are marked above.
apply.error.generic: We could not send your application. Nothing was lost. Please try again in a moment.
apply.error.ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE: This item is not available right now. Please pick another one.
apply.error.ASSET_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this item. Please pick another one.
apply.error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some answers are not in a form we can read. Please check them and try again.
apply.error.MISSING_ANSWERS: Some questions are still unanswered. Please check the form and try again.
apply.error.MIXED_CATEGORIES: One application can only cover one kind of item. Please apply for the other kinds separately.
apply.error.PRICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: We have no price for this item today. Please pick another one or try again later.
apply.error.UNKNOWN_CUSTOMER: We could not find this customer. Please pick someone from the list.
apply.result.approved.title: Good news: approved
apply.result.approved.body: Your application passed every check. The contract to sign is the next step.
apply.result.rejected.title: We cannot approve this right now
apply.result.rejected.body: This is not a verdict on you. Here is the reason, in plain words.
apply.result.pending.title: Almost there: another person must sign
apply.result.pending.body: Your application is fine so far. We are waiting for someone who is allowed to sign.
apply.result.manual_review.title: A person will check your application
apply.result.manual_review.body: We have not said no. For this kind of case a person always takes a look before we decide.
apply.result.adultOn: You turn 18 on {date}. Come back then and we will gladly help you.
apply.result.signatory: We will contact {email} about the signing.
apply.reason.MIN_AGE: You need to be 18 or older to sign a lease.
apply.reason.RESIDENCY: We can lease only to people who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
apply.reason.AFFORDABILITY_EXCEEDED: The monthly rent incl. VAT is more than 30 % of your monthly net income. A cheaper item, a longer term or a bigger down payment may help.
apply.reason.AFFORDABILITY_NOT_ASSESSED: We could not check the monthly rent against your income.
apply.reason.BUSINESS_ID_INVALID: The business ID is not valid. Please check it for typing mistakes.
apply.reason.PEP_MANUAL_REVIEW: People in important public roles are always checked by a person. This is a rule for everyone, not a doubt about you.
apply.reason.FINANCED_OUT_OF_RANGE: The amount we would finance must be between 300 and 250,000 euro. Try a different item, number or down payment.
apply.reason.SIGNATORY_REQUIRED: The person applying cannot sign for the company. Someone who is allowed to sign for the company must sign the contract.
apply.reason.UNKNOWN: Another rule applied. Please contact us and we will explain.
